integrity_note: The analytic argument is self-contained modulo the cited general Poisson-process theorem. Exact finite enumerations check identities but do not certify infinite statements. Historical priority is subject to independent review.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number of distinct subtree-size labels in a fixed positive square-root window; only the uniform BST model. Total-variation rate applies to the matching discrete Poisson field, not to the continuum process. No claim for growing mark sets, recursive trees or general fringe shapes.
title: Critical-scale fringe subtrees form a multitype spatial Poisson process
